title: Zesty Croatian Beef Stew
description: A bitter, velvety Croatian stew with ground beef, dashi extract, and anti-inflammatory spices that evokes nostalgic flavors.
instructions: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium‑high heat until shimmering.
Add diced onion and minced garlic, sauté until onion turns translucent, about 3 minutes.
Stir in sliced carrot and celery, cook for 5 minutes until vegetables soften.
Add ground beef, break up with a spoon, brown until fully cooked, about 8 minutes.
Stir in tomato paste, dashi extract, smoked paprika, sea salt, and black pepper; cook for 2 minutes to bloom flavors.
Pour in 2 cups of water, add bay leaf, bring to a gentle simmer.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and let stew simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Remove bay leaf, taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Ladle stew into bowls, garnish with chopped fresh parsley.
Serve hot with crusty gluten‑free bread if desired.
